newsitem.title: USA: PepsiCo says repositioning Diet Pepsi.
newsitem.headline: PepsiCo says repositioning Diet Pepsi.

text.p: PepsiCo Inc said Tuesday that, in an effort to reposition Diet Pepsi's look and image, it was launching a national effort which included a new advertising campaign, a new tagline highlighting the diet cola's taste, new package graphics and a national cross-promotion with Frito-Lay.
Kicking-off the efforts, Diet Pepsi will unveil its new "This Is Diet?" advertising campaign this week with two new commercials, one of which features NYPD-Blue star Dennis Franz, Pepsi said.
The soft drinks and fast food giant said it has also designed more contemporary packaging and logos for Diet Pepsi and Caffeine-Free Diet Pepsi.
In a further marketing effort next week, Pepsi said some Diet Pepsi products will carry cents-off coupons on certain Frito Lay products, and Frito Lay will carry coupons on Diet Pepsi.
